title: Malformed Lines
instruction: Our collector occasionally writes malformed JSON lines or records with missing/invalid fields. logtool currently aborts the entire report. Skip invalid nonblank lines, continue aggregating valid records, and include "Skipped: N" in the summary (including zero). Blank lines do not count as skipped. A readable input containing malformed records, even entirely malformed records, must exit 0. Preserve failures for unreadable input files and usage errors, and leave direct parseLine validation strict.
